scope: Synchronous P180/D155 cells on disjoint RAN home GPUs. Qualification is mode-specific over home cell count, recovery bound, executor ordering, lifecycle, shared-AI broker, declared control-plane fault class, and the full synchronous prepare/commit/complete budget and post-apply fault-point coverage; later falsification demotes earlier finite-sample points. C134 adds an independent allocation and node requalification for the full-budget three-control-point QSU mode within the same A100 hardware family. Version 9 derives conditional recovery release per home from that home's admitted NeuralRx jobs and is audited against an independent exact endpoint-admission oracle. Version 10 further distinguishes W+Delta capacity geometry from the sufficient exchange window at the current observe-all decision boundary; the latter charges the latest admitted NeuralRx path bound and sequential recovery for rejected NeuralRx jobs before testing an AI transaction. Version 11 caps synchronous NeuralRx admission by the physical CUDA-IPC ring depth and makes rejected-recovery-before-exchange an executor-mode property.

classification.MI: mandatory timing or per-home memory infeasible
classification.UQ: memory/timing arithmetic is feasible but a timing, lifecycle, executor-conformance, control-fault, complete control-budget, or comparison gate is not physically qualified
